info.title: Angelia local API
info.summary: Talk to a running Angelia daemon from scripts and apps on the same machine.
info.description: Served over a Unix socket, `~/.angelia/api.sock` (mode 600), never a network port. Example: `curl --unix-socket ~/.angelia/api.sock -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.angelia/api.token)" http://localhost/profiles`. A request body is a JSON object of at most 256 KB. Routes tagged `stable` are version 1 of the contract: within it they only gain (new optional fields in, new fields and event types out, new routes). Routes tagged `internal` serve Angelia's own clients and may change in any release.

post.summary: Post a line into a routed chat
post.description:
A line `MEDIA:<absolute path>` in the text attaches that file (not from another profile's agent). No agent sees the line. Another profile's agent may post when neither profile is isolated and the hourly limit between profiles allows it; the line says who sent it.

Token: The owner's token, or an agent's own (`ANGELIA_API_TOKEN`) for its own chat. Where the route says so, an agent's token also works for another profile's chat, with `from`.

key.description: A routed chat as `platform:chat`, such as `telegram:123456` or `whatsapp:1203630000…@g.us`; `angelia profiles --json` lists them.

from.description: An agent writing into another profile's chat names its own chat here; its own token then counts. Not for the owner.

token.description: The token, for clients that predate the Authorization header. Prefer the header.

post.summary: Attach a file to a routed chat
post.description:
An agent's token works for its own chat only, and attaches only what its profile may read. Audio goes as a voice note unless `voice` is false.

post.summary: Type a prompt into a chat's session
post.description:
Queued; the answer goes to the chat, or, with `reply: caller`, to the event stream only. Watch `/events` for the turn id. An agent's prompt is plain text, never a CLI command. Another profile's agent may give a task only when the target lists it in `accept_from`. 429: the chat already holds 10 turns, running and waiting; try again after it answers.

Token: The owner's token, or an agent's own (`ANGELIA_API_TOKEN`) for its own chat. Where the route says so, an agent's token also works for another profile's chat, with `from`.

key.description: A routed chat as `platform:chat`, such as `telegram:123456` or `whatsapp:1203630000…@g.us`; `angelia profiles --json` lists them.

from.description: An agent writing into another profile's chat names its own chat here; its own token then counts. Not for the owner.

reply.description: Owner only: the answer comes back as events, never to the chat; the agent sees the prompt as the owner's, typed in an app.

plain.description: With reply: caller, a text starting with / stays a message.

files.description: With reply: caller only: files for the agent, copied into the profile's inbox.

token.description: The token, for clients that predate the Authorization header. Prefer the header.

turn.description: The id the turn's events carry.

post.summary: Ask a chat's agent a question and wait for the answer
post.description:
A read-only copy of the chat's session answers: it reads files and nothing else, and keeps nothing. Up to ten minutes. The chat does not get the answer. A DM with an owner gets one line saying a question was asked; a group gets nothing. Another profile's agent may ask only when the target lists it in `answer_from`, neither profile is isolated, and the hourly limit between profiles allows it.

Token: The owner's token, or an agent's own (`ANGELIA_API_TOKEN`) for its own chat. Where the route says so, an agent's token also works for another profile's chat, with `from`.

get.description:
Server-sent events: each `data:` line is one JSON event below. Comment lines (`: ping`) keep an idle stream alive. A client that stops reading is cut off; it reconnects and reads what it missed from `/history`. New event types may appear: ignore unknown ones.

Token: The owner's token (`~/.angelia/api.token`) only.

200.description: A server-sent event stream; each `data:` line is one event of this shape.

oneOf.description: A turn began. `surface: app`: the owner typed it in a client, and the answer goes back to that client only.
A line the agent said along the way.
A line the chat got (or, for an app turn, would have got).
The agent waits for a yes or no; answer it with POST /permission.

get.summary: A chat's conversation, from the CLI's own record
get.description:
Angelia keeps no copy of messages: each CLI's own session files are read. The first page holds the newest messages; within a page, items are oldest first. For older messages, pass the page's `cursor` as `before`.

Token: The owner's token (`~/.angelia/api.token`) only.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The `cursor` of a page you have: you get the messages just before (older than) that page.

session.description: The session read; null when the chat has none yet.

supported.description: False for a CLI whose history Angelia cannot read yet.

tools.description: Tools the assistant used in this message, each once.

more.description: Older messages exist before the first item.

cursor.description: With `more`: pass it as `before` to get the page of older messages. Opaque.

items.text: Two things: the dentist at 10:30, and the invoice for March is due.
